modelPreview.title: 3D preview
modelPreview.mouse: Drag to turn · Right drag to pan · Scroll to zoom

media.title: Media
media.subtitle: A shared bank of demos, screenshots and rendered videos.
media.empty: No matching media. Record a demo or take a screenshot in a client, then scan its folders.
media.name: Name
media.compatibility: The selected client needs the map and mod used by this demo. Protocol compatibility depends on the engine.
media.exportHint: A 720p video with sound. Settings are remembered for the next export. Rendering runs in the background; progress appears in Media.
media.needJamme: Install a jaMME client to render videos.
media.aviHint: This video is AVI. Open its folder to play it externally. Install FFmpeg next to jaMME for MP4 output in later exports.
media.legacyPreviewHint: This older AVI needs a compatible preview. The original file is preserved.
media.renderCommandsHint: Game CFG commands run before the demo, after the FOV setting. For example: cg_draw2D 0. Commands can override FOV. Mouse input stays disabled for background capture.
media.invalidRenderSettings: Enter an integer FOV from 1 to 160 and up to 32 KiB of commands.
media.captureProgressHint: Background capture. Recorded time and file size update as frames are written; the total demo duration is not known yet.
media.backgroundRender: You can use the launcher while the video is being created.
media.deleteHint: The item, its file in the Media bank and its preview will be deleted. Originals in client folders and other media items stay intact. Scanning will not import this item again.
media.deleteRenderingHint: Finish or cancel this demo’s export before deleting it.
media.deleteSelectedHint: The selected items, their Media bank files and previews will be deleted. Originals in client folders stay intact. Scanning will not import these items again.

configs.title: Configs
configs.subtitle: Reusable game settings, layered by priority, with a dedicated bind editor.
configs.priorityHint: Enabled configs run from lowest to highest priority. At equal priority, their assignment order is used. The last setting wins.
configs.empty: Create a config or import settings saved by a game client.
configs.name: Config name
configs.importSource: Imported from {{source}}. Import again after changing settings in the game.
configs.importHint: Choose a configuration saved by the game. The shared copy does not overwrite the original. To bring in later game edits, import the file again and merge the versions.
configs.mergeHint: Choose the winning value for each conflicting setting. Original commands are retained; selected resolutions run last. External exec files and vstr scripts are not expanded.
configs.removeHint: Remove this config from the list and client assignments? Its file is kept on disk for recovery.
configs.bindIntro: Edit phrases, commands or a player-profile switch. Raw vstr scripts are preserved in the config editor.
configs.profileSnapshot: The bind captures the selected profile and optional config as they are saved. Create it again after editing the profile.
configs.defaultHint: Saved for this client. Applied after startup settings and before additional configs.
configs.defaultsUnavailable: Client settings are unavailable. The keyboard may not show all assigned keys.
configs.unresolvedDefaults: Some commands could not be resolved: {{sources}}. Their key bindings may differ in game.
configs.bindPreviewHint: Preview with this config applied last. Save and enable it to use these bindings in game.
configs.layerOverrideHint: An enabled config supplies this binding. A later config can override your change.

configStudio.shortcuts: Ctrl+Space autocomplete · Ctrl+F find · Ctrl+H replace · Ctrl+Z undo · Tab indent
configStudio.issue_vstr: Variable {{value}} is not defined in this config; it may come from another file.
configStudio.issue_duplicate: {{value}} is assigned more than once. The last value wins.
configStudio.defaultsHint: Pre-filled values come from OpenJK. Only settings marked as overrides are written to this config. Other engines may use different defaults.
configStudio.invalidValue: The value cannot contain quotes or line breaks.
configStudio.templateHint_network: Rate, snapshot frequency and packet settings.
configStudio.templateHint_capture: Hide the HUD and bind F12 to a screenshot.
configStudio.templateHint_cycle: A complete vstr example that toggles the weapon view.
configStudio.reserved: Reserved by the game or operating system
configStudio.keyboardHint: Select a key · Hover to inspect its command
configStudio.pressKey: Press a key · Esc to cancel
configStudio.sharedModifiers: Left and right Ctrl, Alt and Shift share a binding.
